payload.title: Entity chip and score readout components (no JavaScript required)
payload.description:
As a publication builder, I want server-rendered markup and CSS for entity chips and score readouts, so that they work before any script runs.

Entity chip: kind plus name, dashed outline when state is proposed (marks and legend, never colour alone). Score readout: 5-segment meter, value and n; dimmed when below a threshold; text value always present.

```gherkin
Feature: Chip and readout
  Scenario: Proposed chip
    Given an entity in state proposed
    Then the chip is rendered dashed and has the accessible text "proposed"

  Scenario: Low score
    Given a score below the threshold
    Then the readout is dimmed and its text value is still present
```
